description: Erection of single storey rear and side extensions to facilitate creation of a one bed flat (Use Class C3) (retrospective)
decision_conditions: The proposed development by reason of its design, scale, massing and position would result in an obtrusive and incompatible form of development that would fail to respect the character and appearance of the subject property and the Northwold and Cazenove Conservation Area. As such, the proposed development is contrary to policies D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach), D4 (Delivering good design) and HC1 (Heritage conservation and growth) of the London Plan 2021, policies LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character), LP3 (Designated Heritage Assets) and LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020), and the guidance contained within Hackney Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2009).

The proposed dwelling, by reason of the provision of a sub-standard layout would result in the provision of housing with an unacceptable standard of accommodation to the detriment of the residential amenities of the future occupiers of the development, and contrary to policies D6 (Housing quality and standards) and D7 (Accessible housing) of the London Plan 2021 and policies LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character) and LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan 2020.

The proposed development, in the absence of a legal agreement to secure a contribution towards affordable housing fails to deliver the maximum reasonable amount of affordable housing and is therefore contrary to policy H4 (Delivering affordable housing) of the London Plan (2021), policy LP13 (Affordable housing) of Hackney’s Local Plan 2033 (2020) and Hackney's S106 Planning Contributions SPD (2020).

The proposed development, in the absence of a legal agreement to secure car-free housing, would be likely to promote the use of non-sustainable modes of transport and contribute to air pollution and congestion in the surrounding area, contrary to policy T6 of the London Plan (2021), policy LP45 (Parking and Car Free Development) and LP58 (Improving the Environment - Pollution) of Hackney’s Local Plan 2033 (2020) and Hackney's S106 Planning Contributions SPD (2020).

The proposed development, due to insufficient information to assess the sustainability of the development and the absence of a legal agreement to secure a carbon offset contribution, would fail to mitigate the impact of the development on climate change and maximise sustainable development contrary to contrary to policy SI2 (Minimising Greenhouse Gas Emissions) of the London Plan (2021), policy LP55 (Mitigating Climate Change) of Hackney’s Local Plan 2033 (2020) and Hackney's S106 Planning Contributions SPD (2020).
